verdict.rationale: Honcho's docs say the core is open source on GitHub and that users can "run the whole thing yourself and keep your data on your own infrastructure." The CLI's `honcho start` brings up the API, deriver, Postgres, and Redis via Docker, and the MCP server can also run locally instead of the hosted endpoint. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment, detailed production self-hosting documentation (configuration, scaling, upgrades).
